map.在线音频变速工具，上传音频调节播放速度，可勾选保持原音调（变速不变调），导出 W: Online audio speed tool: upload audio, adjust the playback speed, optionally keep the original pitch (speed change without pitch shift), and export as WAV. Suitable for podcasts and language learning; processed entirely in the front end.
map.把长讲座或会议录音整体提速复听，快速定位需要精听的关键段落。: Speed up a long lecture or meeting recording to review it and quickly locate the key passages that need close listening.
map.核心是在不改变基频的前提下重排音频的时间结构：先用重叠相加（OLA）分帧，再用: The core is to rearrange the time structure of the audio without changing the fundamental frequency: first frame the signal with overlap-add (OLA), then use WSOLA to search adjacent frames for the most similar waveform alignment, or use a phase vocoder to unwrap the phase in the frequency domain. Playback speed changes while pitch is preserved.
map.语言学习时把慢速播客或公开课加速到 1.25x~1.5x 节省时间，同时保留原语: In language learning, speed up a slow podcast or open course to 1.25x-1.5x to save time while keeping the original intonation for shadowing and imitation.
map.适度范围（约 0.5x~2x）内算法失真很小；过度变速会出现金属感或抖动，且加速: Within a moderate range (roughly 0.5x-2x) the algorithm introduces very little distortion; extreme speed changes produce a metallic or jittery sound, and speeding up compresses silence while slowing down stretches the reverb tail. Before exporting, audition the boundary speeds to confirm they sound natural.
map.：一段采样率 44100Hz、时长 120 秒的语音，加速到 1.5x 后播放时: : for a 120 second voice clip at 44100 Hz, speeding it up to 1.5x gives a playback duration of about 120 / 1.5 = 80 seconds, with the playback rate at 1.5x and the pitch unchanged. If it were merely resampled (without pitch preservation) the pitch would rise by about 7 semitones and sound cartoonish, so front-end time stretching needs WSOLA or a phase vocoder to rearrange in the time domain and correct phase.
